Theta GmbH’s strategy of filing for multiple patents on next-generation wireless communication is a high-impact move designed to secure a temporary monopoly. This will likely create significant barriers to entry for us, potentially stalling our current development roadmap and forcing us to invest time and resources into finding alternative technological solutions or licensing agreements. This shifts the competitive landscape from one of open innovation to one of legal and technical constraint, requiring us to reassess our R&D priorities and risk management strategies.

Regarding your priority question: A book is primarily made of paper (or other similar materials like parchment or digital screens in the case of e-books) and ink.
